title: enckea amalago
intro: Enckea amalago, commonly known as the forest fern, is a type of flowering plant native to tropical Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health due to its diuretic and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Enckea amalago include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
